name: Lychee Broken Link Checker
description: Quickly check links in Markdown, HTML, and text files

debug.description: Enable debug output in action (set -x). Helpful for troubleshooting.

fail.description: Fail entire pipeline on error (i.e. when lychee exit code is not 0)

failIfEmpty.description: Fail entire pipeline if no links were found

jobSummary.description: Write GitHub job summary at the end of the job (written on Markdown output only)

lycheeVersion.description: Use custom version of lychee link checker

checkbox.description: Add Markdown Styled Checkboxes to the output

token.description: Your GitHub Access Token, defaults to: {{ github.token }}
